# spokes-api/types/v1/timestamp.proto



## Types

<a name="github.spokes.types.v1.Timestamp"></a>

### Timestamp
Timestamp represents an instant with time zone information.


| Field | Type | Label | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| timestamp | [google.protobuf.Timestamp](https://developers.google.com/protocol-buffers/docs/reference/google.protobuf#google.protobuf.Timestamp) |  | <p>timestamp is the instant from the Unix epoch.</p> |
| offset | [int32](https://developers.google.com/protocol-buffers/docs/proto3#scalar) |  | <p>offset is the offset in seconds from UTC.</p> |
